config._adjudication: fastchess.sh's line verbatim, including twosided=true (S212, DEC-174). adocs/data/S085_spsa_run.json's one-sided extra is the record of what S085 ran and is not a template.
config._book: books/UHO_4060_v3.epd and not the harness book. adocs/eval_tuning_strategy.md par.7 and DEV_MANUAL's 'Tune search parameters with SPSA' both say a run must not tune on the openings its verification plays, and since DEC-189 fastchess.sh verifies on books/noob_3moves.epd -- so this lane tunes on the second UHO-class book books/fetch_book.sh pins for exactly that purpose, as S222's lane did (DEC-209 clause 1). 30000 rounds against 242201 openings, so the book never wraps.
config._not_here: No Tm* axis. DEC-094 kept the nine time-management parameters out of S085 because a run tunes at a control its verification does not share, and DEC-200 additionally found TmHardPercent reachable by no node-count probe at all -- so it is excluded from every config, this one included. No second bound either: the two tables share CONT_HIST_BOUND as a definition, because a bound and a weight over one table are one degree of freedom and an axis on the gauge random-walks (DEC-209 clause 2, applied to the second table unchanged).
config._seed: 231, this step's own id. Traceable and not tuned: S222 used 222 for the same reason, and a seed chosen for its trajectory is a result chosen after the number.
config._what: S231's narrow continuation-history lane. The three two-ply axes this step adds together with S222's three one-ply ones -- six axes, one night, at S085's regime. adocs/data/S231_spsa.sh is the pre-registration and the runner; this file is the frozen input. What the SPRT after it judges is the whole six-axis vector and not any one of them (DEC-210's reading, one vector under one verdict).
config._why_these_six_and_nothing_else: The step's accepts names exactly these: the three new axes together with S222's three. The two tables share one quiet band and one reference depth, so their scales are only meaningful against each other and a lane that moved one pair while pinning the other would be fitting a ratio it had fixed by hand. Plain history's six coefficients and QuietHistoryMax are deliberately NOT here: S222's lane fitted them on 2026-09-14 over 60000 of this project's own games and S127 refits everything after the block, so re-fitting them inside this lane would spend the night's resolution on axes that already have a fit and would widen the vector the SPRT has to carry. HistPruneCoeff is out for the same reason and for DEC-209 clause 3's: it reads the raw plain entry, not the sum, and moving its input is another step's change.

params.name: ContHistBonus
params.why: S222's one-ply share, in thousandths of that table's band at remaining depth 11. Starts at its own fitted value, not at its seed: S222's lane fitted it 15 -> 17 over 60000 games and the incumbent is what an SPSA run starts from. c_end 2 is S222's, a ninth of the start and 1/500 of the range.

params.name: ContHistMalus
params.why: The same unit for the one-ply malus, at its fitted 18. In the lane because the two tables' shares are only meaningful against each other.

params.name: ContHistWeight
params.why: How much of the quiet band the one-ply term spans, at its fitted 26. **The range is 0 to 1000 and not S222's 0 to 2000**: two weighted terms now share one band and the band-clearance ceiling is a property of their total, so each declares half of it -- 1000 and 1000 span the same 655340 that 2000 alone did, and the clearance against the countermove band is the same 11893 (src/search_params.hpp carries the arithmetic, tests/test_evaluation.cpp asserts it). The fitted value is nowhere near either edge and is untouched. c_end 4 is S222's.

params.name: ContHist2Bonus
params.why: S231's own. The two-ply table's bonus share, in the same unit at the same reference depth, seeded at the one-ply table's fitted 17 because the two are written at the same call site over the same spans into bands of the same width -- a derivation over this project's own fitted number and no other engine's (DEC-084 as amended by DEC-105). Same c_end as the axis it was seeded from.

params.name: ContHist2Malus
params.why: The same for the malus, seeded at the one-ply table's fitted 18. Separate from the bonus because the split is what the one-ply lane found asymmetric on plain history and nothing here has measured it for either continuation table.

params.name: ContHist2Weight
params.why: The axis this lane exists for: how much of the quiet band the two-ply term spans. Seeded at 26, which spans 26 * 32767 / 100 = 8519 -- exactly what the one-ply term spans at its fitted 26, against plain history's fitted QuietHistoryMax of 8831, so the three terms start at 8831 / 8519 / 8519 and the two tables start with equal authority. **Deliberately not seeded at 0**: an axis that starts at a bound is a known pathology here, S085's RfpMinPly sat at one for 72.5 % of that run's iterations, and a lane whose whole subject is this weight cannot afford to start it switched off. c_end 4, the weight axis's own.
